content.title: Why Tandem Diabetes (TNDM) Stock Is Up Today
content.summary: Shares of diabetes technology company Tandem Diabetes Care (NASDAQ:TNDM) jumped 5% in the morning session after the company announced the publication of a study showing its automated insulin delivery system was beneficial for adults with type 2 diabetes, while a broader market rally fueled by a Federal Reserve interest rate cut also provided a tailwind.
